current_review_handoffs.finding: Inventory paging bounds missing IDs, not transmitted IDs or work. A mostly synchronized peer can request every page again on each session and repeatedly hit the 120-second deadline before reaching a later missing object.
current_review_handoffs.minimal_resolution: Add a bounded transmitted-ID/work budget plus resumable inventory cursor semantics; preserve progress across sessions rather than restarting from the first page.
current_review_handoffs.acceptance: Large near-synchronized-store test proves per-session work stays bounded and a later missing ID is eventually reached across resumed sessions; test deadline and restart behavior.
current_review_handoffs.handoff_status: Not sent. No accountable T03 or T06 human is recorded. The current client counts only missing IDs toward its budget, so an already-held prefix can be retransmitted on every session. Agree the cursor persistence and compatibility contract with the transport and storage owners before changing the shared wire/store interface.

current_review_handoffs.finding: service run scans/reconciles the blob quota before checking the service instance lock, so a duplicate start can block active workers before reporting that the service is already running.
current_review_handoffs.minimal_resolution: Acquire the instance lock before quota reconciliation while preserving service stop/status serialization.
current_review_handoffs.local_status: On isolated checkout at PR base head 2873ca489fe646e48501060a5e551c58f18a7b21: the service-lock regression proves a duplicate start checks the lock before reading a deliberately corrupt quota index; the authenticated service integration test waits for owner persistence before Bob syncs; shell scripts are pinned to LF; tools/check_native_forge.py respects an existing CARGO_TARGET_DIR. The documented python3 tools/check_native_forge.py --release --offline path passed, including selected CLI acceptance tests, mini-forge/mini-sync suites, clippy, fmt and optimized mini-cli build. GitHub head checks were also all green when refreshed. Patch is local only, not committed or pushed.
current_review_handoffs.acceptance: Concurrent-start regression proves the second process exits promptly without holding the active quota lock or delaying peer ingress.

current_review_handoffs.finding: Workspace snapshots count both directories and files against MAX_CHECKOUT_FILES, while checkout limits files; a valid checkout-sized tree can fail an unchanged commit.
current_review_handoffs.minimal_resolution: Give directories a separate bounded budget or make snapshot node limits cover every tree checkout accepts.
current_review_handoffs.acceptance: Round-trip test commits an unchanged checkout near MAX_CHECKOUT_FILES across many directories and still rejects trees above the agreed node/file limits.
